sprint_goal: Deliver a secure, production-ready MVP payment admin workspace integrating PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs for search, approvals, refunds, anomaly alerts, and audit export.

tasks.title: Implement merchant and payment batch search UI
tasks.description: Build Next.js search components using shadcn/ui, integrate PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs via API Gateway for query data, ensuring <1.5s response time.

tasks.title: Develop settlement timeline visualization
tasks.description: Create timeline component with event stream grouping per payment rail type (ACH, RTP, wire). Integrate Payment Rail API data and implement responsive layout.

tasks.title: Integrate refund and adjustment triggers
tasks.description: Set up backend connector to Payment Actions service to process refund/adjustment actions with mTLS+OAuth2 authentication and emit audit logs to Kafka and S3.

tasks.title: Develop approval workflow with automated allocation rules
tasks.description: Implement Manager view for payout approval using PaymentCore data, trigger Payment Rail disbursements, enforce RBAC gating, and log actions to audit topics.

tasks.title: Implement RBAC middleware and feature gating
tasks.description: Configure RBAC roles (OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor) within workspace with route-level and component-level gating, ensuring no privilege escalation.

tasks.title: Build audit-ready report export module
tasks.description: Develop Auditor view to fetch S3 archived logs via gateway and generate audit-ready CSV/XLSX files for selected date ranges, adhering to SOX compliance.

tasks.title: Implement anomaly alert display in batch views
tasks.description: Render real-time alerts from Payment Rail event streams, highlight anomalies, and add quick investigation links in batch detail UI.

tasks.title: Performance and integration testing
tasks.description: Test API round-trip times, role access validation, payout initiation SLA, audit log delivery to Kafka/S3, and UI responsiveness under load.

tasks.title: Deployment pipeline setup inside private VNet
tasks.description: Configure CI/CD for Next.js and backend APIs using existing runners in private VNet, ensure mTLS and OAuth2 secrets managed securely, deploy to prod environment.

tasks.title: Create workspace usage documentation
tasks.description: Develop internal guide explaining search, approval, refund processes, RBAC behaviors, and audit log handling for Ops, Managers, and Auditors.

risks.description: API latency exceeds performance targets during integration testing affecting search and payout initiation times.
risks.mitigation: Implement query caching and pagination, collaborate with infra team for API gateway tuning and parallel requests.

risks.description: Audit log emission failures or Kafka/S3 downtime risk incomplete compliance records.
risks.mitigation: Add retry mechanism and alerting for failed audit emissions; validate S3 archive success post-deployment.

risks.description: RBAC misconfiguration may allow unauthorized access to approval actions.
risks.mitigation: Perform manual role simulation testing and integrate automated permission validation in CI.

risks.description: Integration dependencies on Payment Rail API schemas could change mid-sprint.
risks.mitigation: Use versioned API endpoints and coordinate with API owners before sprint commit.

risks.description: Deployment in private VNet may delay CI/CD setup due to restricted network policies.
risks.mitigation: Pre-request network firewall exceptions and reuse existing runner configurations.

definition_of_done: All user stories pass functional and integration tests.
Performance meets <1.5s search and <4s payout SLA under load testing.
RBAC verified for OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor without escalation.
Audit logs confirmed in Kafka and S3 for all actions.
Workspace deployed to production environment inside private VNet.
Documentation completed and reviewed by Treasury Operations stakeholders.
